key_primary_source_propositions.proposition: The memory states that the 17 June 2008 EUR 1.368m sale, in parallel with apartment sales by certain shareholders, meant cessation of the company's activity and that transferred assets were placed at the purchaser's disposal for exploitation.
The memory states that the 17 June 2008 sale executed an option signed 12 March 2008 and links it to partial repayment of shareholder contributions.
The memory states there was no employment during 2012 and that the company had remained inactive for some years.

limits: Does not by itself prove the title chain for every unit.
